title: Atomic Chat PrismML llama.cpp Backends Manifest
description: Schema for the release catalog of the `atomic-prism` provider: prebuilt PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp archives the core installs to run Bonsai models. Every release is pinned by tag, commit and per-asset sha256. A release reaches users only through an asset marked `approved`; `candidate` assets exist for maintainers and for clients that explicitly opt into unverified builds. Clients ignore releases whose `min_core_version` is newer than themselves, so a new field or backend can be published without breaking cores already installed.

upstream_repo.description: GitHub repository the releases come from (PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp).

download_base.description: Base URL the client prepends to '<tag>/<asset name>'. Absent means the upstream repository's GitHub release download URL.

releases.description: Newest first. The client chooses among approved, non-withdrawn releases its own version can read.

tag.description: PrismML release tag, prism-b<build>-<sha7>. The build number orders releases.

min_core_version.description: Oldest atomic-chat-core that understands this entry. Older cores skip it.

notes_url.description: Release notes page shown next to an update offer.

notes.description: Optional one-line summary shown in the update banner.

supersedes.description: Releases this one replaces; installs on them are offered this release first.

withdrawn.description: A release pulled from recommendations. Installed packs are kept; clients offer to move off it.

capabilities.description: Model formats and transforms this release runs. Matched against the capabilities a model file needs (models/atomic-prism-models.json).

backend.description: Stable backend id the client selects on; never derived from the asset name at runtime.

validation.description: approved: passed real-hardware acceptance and is recommended to users. candidate: published by the release watch, not yet verified.

companion.description: True for the Windows CUDA runtime archive unpacked into the matching CUDA pack.

companion_backend.description: The companion archive a Windows CUDA pack needs.

min_driver.description: Minimum NVIDIA driver for a CUDA pack.

min_compute_capability.description: Lowest NVIDIA compute capability the pack carries kernels for.
